explanation: Encodes Erdős's [Er81] conjecture that the n^{3/2} bound can be improved to ≪ n^{1+ε} for every ε > 0, with the graph chosen after ε. The docstring makes this choice explicit. Choosing the graph after ε is the weaker of the two readings, while a single G working for all ε would be stronger, and the source wording supports either. It is correctly marked open.
